notes: Verified against Roblox Studio UGCValidation Lua source (version-8d7a1009c17e4ff8) and live Roblox Avatar Item Category validator outputs.

rules.name: Curve Types Allowed
rules.source: UGCValidation/CurveAnimAllowedTypes.lua & CurveAnimStrictSchema.lua (Studio Studio Post-Process enforces this; FBX is converted cleanly in Studio).
rules.description: Only MarkerCurve, AnimationRigData, Folder, Vector3Curve, EulerRotationCurve, and FloatCurve are allowed in CurveAnimation. Quaternion RotationCurve instances are rejected.

rules.name: Joint Manipulation Present
rules.description: At least one of the 15 mapped joints must have non-constant rotational motion (rotation delta >= 0.001 rad) or Roblox fails with 'Curve Animation does not contain any joint manipulation'.

rules.name: Max Body Part & Virtual Tip Linear Speed
rules.source: Roblox Avatar Validator (Roxie reference rig: LeftHandPinky3 57.94, RightHandPinky3 51.39 vs 51.00 max) & UGCValidation/CurveAnimSpeedBounded.lua
rules.description: No body part center or virtual hand/foot tip may exceed 51.0 studs/s relative to HumanoidRootPart when sampled at 30 fps and 70 fps. Auto-fix targets <= 45.0 studs/s to account for Roxie rig variance.

rules.name: Max Joint Angular Velocity (Heuristic)
rules.description: Heuristic angular speed warning when any joint rotates faster than 1750 deg/s between sampled frames.

rules.name: Max Floor Penetration Depth
rules.source: Roblox Avatar Validator on Roxie reference avatar ('0.13 studs below the floor at 0.00 seconds. The allowed depth is 0.1 studs')
rules.description: No foot bounding corner may drop more than 0.10 studs below the standing floor plane at any sampled timestamp.

rules.name: Non-LowerTorso Translation Limit
rules.description: Only LowerTorso may translate; all other 14 joints must have <= 0.30 studs translation (default auto-fix strips all non-LowerTorso translation to 0).

rules.name: Key Spacing / Frame Rate Bounds
rules.description: Adjacent keyframes cannot be closer than 1/70 s, and total animation length must be in (0, 10.0] s.

rules.name: Max Joint Angle From Rest
rules.description: Every joint rotation from rest pose must remain <= 180 degrees at every sample.

rules.name: Lowest Body Point Height (Soft)
rules.description: Soft check that no body part drops below -3.1 studs from HumanoidRootPart or travels farther than 25.0 studs.

rules.name: Animation Pack Manifest Schema
rules.description: Each animation slot container must have exact StringValue names and exact Animation child count (1 per slot, 2 for idle).

rules.name: Loop Seam Continuity
rules.description: For looping clips, first and last poses should match within angle/position tolerance without velocity discontinuity across the wrap.

rules.name: Numerical & Curve Sanity
rules.description: Rejects NaN/Inf values, empty tracks, non-monotonic key times, and non-unit quaternions.
